stem: ![](asset:P000575-stem-1)Two blocks are placed one-above-other as shown and are connected with string and pulley as shown. The strings are horizontal. The coefficient of friction between two blocks is 0.1 and 0.2 between 4 kg block and the floor. Find the minimum force F required to cause slipping?

assets.alt: A 2 kg block on a 4 kg block, joined by a string round a pulley fixed to a wall; μ = 0.1 between the blocks and μ = 0.2 under the 4 kg block; a force F pulls the 4 kg block away from the wall.
The 2 kg block moves right as the 4 kg block moves left under F. 2 kg: T = 0.1(20) = 2; 4 kg: F = T + 2 + 0.2(60).
